svg.title: PanicDa3m0n · HoneyLabs
svg.desc: PanicDa3m0n: reverse engineer, cracker and AI researcher. HoneyLabs, independent AI lab. Building digital living beings, opening closed systems, porting console games to the open PC, hunting bugs for Sony, Microsoft and Samsung, designing agent-first operating systems.
